The application provides a lithium ion battery, lithium ion battery includes electrode subassembly and electrolyte, electrode subassembly includes positive pole piece, negative pole piece and barrier film. The positive active material in the positive pole piece comprises LixCoyM1‑yO2‑zQz，0.5≤x≤1.2，0.8≤y<Z is more than or equal to 1.0 and less than or equal to 0.1, M is selected from one or more of Al, Ti, Zr, Y and Mg, and Q is selected from one or more of F, Cl and S. The electrolyte contains an additive A, an additive B and an additive C, wherein the additive A is a polyacrylonitrile-based six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic compound with a low oxidation potential, the additive B is an anhydride compound, and the additive C is a halogen-substituted cyclic carbonate compound. The lithium ion battery has excellent cycle performance and storage performance, and particularly has excellent cycle performance and storage performance under the conditions of high temperature and high voltage.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The present application relates to the field of energy storage materials, and in particular, to a lithium ion battery.

Background

Lithium ion batteries are widely used in electric vehicles and consumer electronics because of their advantages of high energy density, high output power, long cycle life, and low environmental pollution. The current demands for lithium ion batteries are: high voltage, high power, long cycle life, long storage life and excellent safety performance.

LiCoO is widely used in lithium ion batteries at present2As a positive electrode active material, LiCoO in a fully discharged state2And Li in the semi-charged state0.5CoO2Li) is relatively stable when cycled between (4.2V vs. li), so that the actual lithium ions that are actually used are only 1/2 times the actual lithium ion content. And when the voltage is more than 4.2V, LiCoO2The lithium ions with the residual 1/2 content can be continuously extracted, but during the deep lithium extraction process, Co3+Will be oxidized to very unstable Co4+And the electrolyte is oxidized together with surface oxygen losing a large amount of electrons, and a large amount of gas is generated inside the battery at the moment to cause the battery to swell. At the same time, the corrosion of HF in the electrolyte on the anode surface results in Co4+After being dissolved in the electrolyte, the electrolyte is deposited on the surface of the negative electrode, and a large amount of gas is also generated to cause battery swelling by catalyzing the reduction of the electrolyte. In addition, the 3d energy level of Co is greatly overlapped with the 2p energy level of O, deep lithium removal also causes lattice oxygen to lose a large amount of electrons, and LiCoO is caused2The unit cell is severely shrunk along the c-axis direction, local bulk phase structure instability and even collapse are induced, and LiCoO is finally caused2Active site loss and rapid capacity reduction of the lithium ion battery. Thus LiCoO2The performance is very poor when used in high voltage systems above 4.2V.

In view of this, the present application is specifically made.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the problems in the background art, an object of the present application is to provide a lithium ion battery having excellent cycle performance and storage performance, especially excellent cycle performance and storage performance under high temperature and high voltage conditions.

In order to achieve the above object, the present application provides a lithium ion battery, which includes an electrode assembly and an electrolyte, wherein the electrode assembly includes a positive electrode plate, a negative electrode plate and a separation film. The positive active material in the positive pole piece comprises LixCoyM1-yO2-zQz，0.5≤x≤1.2，0.8≤y<Z is more than or equal to 1.0 and less than or equal to 0.1, M is selected from one or more of Al, Ti, Zr, Y and Mg, and Q is selected from one or more of F, Cl and S. Compared with the prior art, the application at least comprises the following beneficial effects:

the application uses a lithium cobaltate material Li doped with a metal ion MxCoyM1-yO2-zQzThe doping element M of the positive electrode active material serves as a framework in the lithium cobaltate material, so that the lattice deformation of the lithium cobaltate material in the deep lithium removal process can be reduced, the degradation of the phase structure of the lithium cobaltate material is delayed, and the structural stability of the lithium ion battery when the lithium ion battery is used under the high voltage of more than 4.2V is improved.

The electrolyte solution of the present application contains a combination additive of additive a, additive B, and additive C. The additive A is a polyacrylonitrile-based six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic compound with lower oxidation potential, and a stable complex layer can be formed on the surface of the positive active material during the formation of the battery, so that the surface of the positive active material is effectively passivated, the surface activity of the positive active material is reduced, and the dissolution of transition metal into electrolyte is inhibited, thereby reducing the gas production of the battery while reducing side reactions; the additive B is an acid anhydride compound, can absorb moisture in the electrolyte, prevents HF generated in the electrolyte from corroding and damaging the surface of the positive active material, has certain acidity after absorbing the moisture, can neutralize the alkalinity of the surface of the positive active material, and reduces the decomposition effect of alkaline metal oxide in the positive active material on organic solvents such as carbonic ester; the additive C halogen-substituted cyclic carbonate compound can form a uniform, thin and flexible SEI film on the surface of a negative electrode (especially the surface of a Si-containing negative electrode), isolate the electronic conduction between the negative electrode and an electrolyte, effectively reduce the side reaction between the negative electrode and the electrolyte, and inhibit the continuous increase of the impedance of the negative electrode, and meanwhile, the toughness of the protective film can also inhibit the expansion of the negative electrode (especially the Si-containing negative electrode) and prevent the electrolyte from being continuously consumed due to the excessive fracture of the SEI film.

The lithium ion battery has excellent cycle performance and storage performance, and particularly has excellent cycle performance and storage performance under the conditions of high temperature and high voltage.

The lithium ion battery has excellent cycle performance and storage performance, and particularly has excellent cycle performance and storage performance under the conditions of high temperature and high voltage. In one aspect, the present application uses a lithium cobaltate material Li comprising a metal ion M dopingxCoyM1-yO2-zQzThe doping element M in the positive electrode active material serves as a framework in the lithium cobaltate material, so that the deep delithiation of the lithium cobaltate material can be reducedThe lattice deformation quantity delays the degradation of the phase structure of the lithium cobaltate material, and the structural stability of the lithium ion battery when the lithium ion battery is used under the high voltage of more than 4.2V is improved. On the other hand, the additive A, the additive B and the additive C are simultaneously added into the electrolyte, and the three additives can play a synergistic effect to jointly protect the lithium ion battery, so that the lithium ion battery has excellent cycle performance and storage performance, and particularly has excellent cycle performance and storage performance under the conditions of high temperature and high voltage.

Specifically, the method comprises the following steps:

(1) the additive A is a polyacrylonitrile-based six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic compound with low oxidation potential, nitrogen atoms in the nitrile groups contain lone pair electrons and have strong complexing effect with transition metals in the positive active material, and the additive A can be adsorbed on the surface of the positive active material to generate a loose and porous complex layer and effectively passivate the surface of the positive active material during battery formation. The complex layer can isolate the direct contact between the surface of the positive active material and electrolyte, reduce the surface activity of the positive active material, reduce a large number of side reactions on the surface of the positive active material, inhibit the transition metal from being dissolved into the electrolyte, and ensure the structural integrity of the positive active material in the use process of the lithium ion battery, thereby effectively improving the cycle capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery under high voltage and reducing the high-temperature storage gas production rate of the lithium ion battery. In addition, the additive A has a special six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic structure, the distance between a nitrile group and a nitrile group is closer to the distance between transition metal and transition metal on the surface of the positive active material, the complexation of the nitrile group can be exerted to the maximum extent, and a greater number of nitrile groups can be exerted to the complexation, so that compared with a conventional linear nitrile group compound, the polynitrile six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic compound disclosed by the application can have a better passivation effect.

(2) The additive B is an acid anhydride compound, which can absorb moisture in the electrolyte, prevent HF generated in the electrolyte from corroding and damaging the surface of the positive electrode active material. The additive B has certain acidity after absorbing water, can neutralize the alkalinity of the surface of the positive active material, and reduces the decomposition effect of alkali metal oxide in the positive active material on organic solvents such as carbonic ester and the like. Therefore, the additive B can also act on the surface of the positive active material, especially on the surface of the positive active material which cannot be protected by the additive A. In addition, although the additive B forms an acid even after absorbing moisture, the acid content is very small and the acidity is much lower than that of HF, and therefore, the surface of the positive electrode active material is not corroded or damaged.

(3) The additive C is a halogen-substituted cyclic carbonate compound, and can form a uniform, thin and flexible SEI film on the surface of a negative electrode (especially the surface of a Si-containing negative electrode), so that the electronic conduction between the negative electrode and an electrolyte is isolated, the side reaction between the negative electrode and the electrolyte is effectively reduced, and the continuous increase of the impedance of the negative electrode is inhibited; meanwhile, the toughness of the protective film can also inhibit the expansion of a negative electrode (especially a Si-containing negative electrode), and prevent the electrolyte from being continuously consumed due to the excessive fracture of an SEI film.
